scope_note: Each row classifies access to and rights in one described resource at the stated scope. The evidence URL is a public metadata, documentation or authoritative source page only; its reachability does not make a linked service, dataset, output or attachment public, free or openly licensed. Additional rights references are independent constraints and never replace the primary resource assessment.
